how_to.title: How to make a Iranian passport photo
how_to.step1_text: Stand in front of a plain background in even light and have someone else take the photo at eye level. Follow the Iranian rules below.
how_to.step2_text: Choose the photo. It is processed in your browser and never uploaded to a server.
how_to.step3_text: Drag the frame to centre your face and use Zoom until your head fills the frame to the size the rules require.
how_to.step4_text: Download the PDF sheet and print it at actual size (100%, no "fit to page") on photo paper, then cut out the photos.

items.q: What size is an Iranian passport photo?
items.a: 3 × 4 cm (30 × 40 mm), in colour, with a plain white background.

items.q: Do women need to wear a headscarf in an Iranian passport photo?
items.a: Yes. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs says women applicants should wear a headscarf according to Iranian regulations.
No. The photo must be without a hat, glasses or a neck scarf.

items.q: How many photos do I need to renew an Iranian passport abroad?
items.a: Three 3 × 4 cm photos taken within the past six months, with your details written on the back.
